method.discovery: Compare official conference contents and accepted-paper programs against existing titles, DOI records and earlier screening decisions. Recheck publisher Crossref deposits for RA-L/T-ASE/T-RO. Inspect author abstracts, projects, implementations and selected full papers before adding omissions.
method.patterns: grasp, gripper, prehensile, bin picking, pick-and-place; supplemental citation/project discovery for grasping perception and hybrid manipulation.
method.scope: Preserve literal title exclusions. Exclude tactile feedback, primary hardware-design contributions, human-only grasping and non-prehensile-only work. Related papers require a verified robot grasping task.
limitations: Title-oriented discovery does not establish exhaustive full-text coverage.
Some Crossref queries returned HTTP 429 and were not retried. Existing OpenAlex limits were respected.
CoRL 2026 has not occurred; NeurIPS 2026 proceedings were unavailable. ICRA 2026 acceptance/program entries may still lack individual publisher DOI pages.
Author code links marked Coming Soon, page templates, publisher archives and dependencies were not accepted as paper implementations.
